result_text:
`listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` now sorts open tickets high, then normal, then low priority. Within a priority they stay oldest first, with the ticket id as the final tie-breaker. It uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority …` as the sales rep's list. I also updated its Javadoc to describe the new order.

The full offline test suite (`mvn -q -o test`) ran with no output, which I'm reading as passing. I didn't add a test for your T-1 to T-5 example, so that ordering isn't checked by a test. Nothing is committed.
